paragraphs.label: Ý 1 — lợi ích thực tế
paragraphs.text: First, students can quickly access useful learning material. This is possible because a shared task can direct phone use towards a specific question rather than casual browsing. People are more likely to value an approach when they can see what it changes in their own lives.
